blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Sibonga and Ginatilan bannered the biggest victories in the Cebu Governor’s Cup Under-18 basketball tournament, posting dominant wins in their South Division assignments over the weekend. Sibonga delivered the biggest winning margin, dismantling Dalaguete, 83-58, at the Talisay City Sports Complex on Saturday, November 7. Adrian Deocampo spearheaded Sibonga’s offensive attack with 20 points. Carl Abella contributed 18 and Chrisler John Medina added 12 to complete their convincing 25-point victory.
